repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: X-連鎖魚鱗病（不含類固醇硫酸酯酶缺乏症）的核心病理為 STS 基因外的其他缺陷，涉及膽固醇硫酸鹽（cholesterol sulfate）積聚與表皮屏障異常。Alirocumab 透過 PCSK9 抑制上調肝臟 LDL 受體、降低循環 LDL-C，作用於血漿膽固醇清除，對皮膚膽固醇硫酸鹽局部代謝缺陷無直接藥理學關聯。高 TxGNN 分數推測來自知識圖譜中「膽固醇代謝」超節點（hypernode）的廣義拓樸關聯，缺乏生物合理性。

predicted_indications.disease_name: disorder of other vitamins and cofactors metabolism and transport

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: PCSK9 抑制的作用路徑高度專一於 LDL 受體循環（LDLR recycling），對維生素（A/D/E/K/B 群等）及輔因子（CoA、FAD、NAD 等）的轉運及代謝酵素系統缺乏任何已知直接調控機轉。此適應症分類過於廣泛，且與 PCSK9 生物學完全不相關。TxGNN 高分為知識圖譜噪訊。

literature.journal: Journal of investigative medicine high impact case reports
literature.abstract: Background. Familial dysbetalipoproteinemia (also known as type 3 hyperlipoproteinemia) is typically associated with homozygosity for the apolipoprotein E2 isoform, but also sometimes with dominant rare missense variants in the APOE gene. Patients present with roughly equimolar elevations of cholesterol and triglyceride (TG) due to pathologic accumulation of remnant lipoprotein particles. Clinical features include tuberoeruptive xanthomas, palmar xanthomas, and premature vascular disease. Case.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 黃色瘤症（xanthomatosis）的病理基礎為膽固醇酯（cholesteryl ester）在巨噬細胞及其他組織中過度沉積，與血漿 LDL-C 長期升高高度相關。Alirocumab 透過 PCSK9 抑制可降低 LDL-C 40-60%，理論上能顯著減緩膽固醇組織沉積速率；已有他汀類藥物縮小黃色瘤的先例支持此路徑。然而，現有 2 篇文獻均為描述伴有黃色瘤的血脂異常案例（植物固醇血症、複合型基因性血脂異常），並非直接評估 alirocumab 治療黃色瘤症的臨床試驗。機轉合理性高（B 級），但臨床直接證據缺失，定位 L4。建議設計針對腱性黃色瘤（tendon xanthoma）患者的 Proof-of-Concept 研究。

These outcomes can be assessed using specialized noninvasive imaging which strongly predict future CV events in the general population.

literature.title: PCSK9-directed therapies: an update.
literature.abstract: Two large cardiovascular outcomes trials of monoclonal antibodies against proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) demonstrated that therapeutic inhibition of extracellular PCSK9 markedly reduces LDL cholesterol concentration and cardiovascular risk. Several novel strategies to inhibit PCSK9 function are in development. Different mechanisms of action may determine specific properties with potential relevance for patient care.

literature.title: Homozygous Familial Hypercholesterolemia Treatment: New Developments.
literature.abstract: Homozygous familial hypercholesterolaemia (HoFH) is characterized by marked elevation of low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDLC) and premature atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease. This is a review of novel pharmacological therapies to lower LDLC in patients with HoFH.

literature.abstract: Proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) has evolved as a pivotal enzyme in lipid metabolism and a revolutionary therapeutic target for hypercholesterolemia and its related cardiovascular diseases (CVD). literature.title: Familial Hypercholesterolemia and Its Current Diagnostics and Treatment Possibilities: A Literature Analysis.
literature.abstract: Familial hypercholesterolemia (FH) is a common, inherited disorder of cholesterol metabolism. This pathology is usually an autosomal dominant disorder and is caused by inherited mutations in the APOB, LDLR, and PCSK9 genes. Patients can have a homozygous or a heterozygous genotype, which determines the severity of the disease and the onset age of cardiovascular disease (CVD) manifestations. literature.abstract: Proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) plays an important role in low-density lipoprotein (LDL) metabolism. Pharmacological PCSK9 inhibitors have been developed as a novel approach to treating dyslipidemia. This article reviews the spectrum of evidence implicating the role of PCSK9 in lipid metabolism and the clinical impact of PCSK9 inhibitors on lipid parameters and cardiovascular risk. Besides the oral treatment with statins, ezetimibe and bempedoic acid, subcutaneously administered inhibitors of proprotein convertase subtilisin-kexin type 9 (PCSK9) have been established as further cornerstones of lipid-lowering treatment. literature.title: PCSK9 and Coronary Artery Plaque-New Opportunity or Red Herring?
literature.abstract: Although the clinical benefit of reducing low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDLc) in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD) is well-established, the impact on plaque composition and stability is less clear. Our narrative review aimed to assess the clinical effects of proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) inhibitors on coronary plaque characteristics specifically focusing from atheroma progression to regression and stabilization.

literature.abstract: Suboptimal response to various proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 inhibitor (PCSK9i) therapies has been reported in the literature; however, inadequate response to proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 monoclonal antibodies and small interference RNA is rare to our knowledge.

literature.abstract: Acute coronary syndromes (ACSs) represent a significant global health challenge arising from atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD), with elevated low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) levels being a primary contributor. Despite standard statin therapy, individuals with ACS remain at high risk for recurrent cardiovascular events, particularly in the initial post-ACS period. repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Alirocumab 為抗 PCSK9 單株抗體（IgG1κ），與 PCSK9 結合後阻止其與肝細胞表面 LDL 受體結合，從而防止 LDL 受體降解（lysosomal degradation），顯著上調肝臟 LDL 受體密度（可增加 2-4 倍），使血漿 LDL-C 降低 40-60%。此機轉與「膽固醇分解代謝疾病」（cholesterol catabolic process disease）的核心病理生理直接契合——無論是家族性高膽固醇血症（FH，LDLR/ApoB/PCSK9 功能獲得性突變）、繼發性血脂異常（HIV 感染、代謝症候群等所致），或其他 LDL 清除受損疾病，均可透過 PCSK9 抑制恢復 LDL 受體功能。現有 1 項已完成 Phase 3 臨床試驗及 19 篇（提供 10 篇）高品質文獻，包含系統性回顧與機轉研究，構成 L2 證據強度。

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 此疾病源於膽固醇生合成酵素缺陷（如 DHCR7 缺陷導致 Smith-Lemli-Opitz 症候群、CYP51A1 缺陷等），影響性腺發育所需膽固醇供應。Alirocumab 作用方向為促進膽固醇清除（分解代謝↑），與此疾病所需之保護/補充內源性膽固醇合成能力的治療方向相悖，理論上有可能加重膽固醇缺乏。高 TxGNN 分數為知識圖譜膽固醇相關節點的方向性誤判（direction-agnostic KG）。

3-羥醯基輔酶A脫氫酶（HADH/SCHAD）缺乏症為粒線體脂肪酸β-氧化（FAO）缺陷，影響中短鏈脂肪酸代謝，臨床表現為低血糖、高胰島素血症及肝臟損傷。此疾病的分子路徑（粒線體 FAO）與 Alirocumab 的作用路徑（肝細胞表面 LDLR 循環 → 血漿 LDL-C 清除）處於完全不同的細胞生化隔室，無藥理學交集。高 TxGNN 分數為 KG 中脂質代謝廣義節點的誤相關（non-specific lipid metabolism node overlap）。
